editorial_assessment.assessment: Six ideas and six arrows were returned, but the checker demoted the scanner-operation endpoint to a supporting idea, so the required route criterion failed. The wavelength-only resolution phrasing also oversimplifies the optical and process assumptions. This is a useful partial explanation, not a complete ancestry map.

The graph connects electric force and ionization through discharge, energetic electrons and deposition. It meets the structural criterion, but two carbon-radical deposition cards substantially repeat each other. The carbon-growth example is correctly scoped to its source and must not be read as a universal PECVD mechanism or chronology.

Momentum conservation, the rocket equation, retrograde burns and recovery form a recognizable path. However, one warrant says propellant is expelled opposite the motion while explaining deceleration; the sign/direction needs correction. The restart/throttle title extends beyond the cited multi-engine description, and a simulated landing-controller example does not establish the control algorithm used by a named launcher. Structural success is not scientific acceptance.

Data parallelism, threads/blocks/grids and kernel execution provide a useful short route. The memory-management card uses universal language that exceeds a scoped description of explicit-memory CUDA programming, and the compiler/toolchain card is isolated. This map should not be treated as a complete account of CUDA memory models or GPU architecture.

The map identifies sequence-based structure prediction, evolutionary information and the Evoformer, but lacks a retained general foundation and a connected explanation of the main mechanism. The alignment-depth bound needs to stay tied to the reported AlphaFold generation and evaluation, rather than all later systems. It fails the structural criterion.

editorial_assessment.query: large language models such as chatgpt
editorial_assessment.assessment: Conditional probability and maximum likelihood connect to autoregressive language modeling and a scoped decoder-only generation endpoint. The bounded refinement restored that endpoint, and the graph meets the structural criterion. It still conflates words with tokens in several cards, includes an isolated historical neural-network summary, and does not establish a complete training or attribution history. Claims about the representative GPT-style branch do not identify the undisclosed architecture of every current ChatGPT model.

output_format_diagnostic.interpretation: All six controlled replays assigned the scanner card the requested-result role in both formats. The original contradictory classification was not reproduced. This small diagnostic does not establish that strict decoding caused it or that either format is more accurate; no review gate was relaxed.

development_failures_retained: Initial patch application rejected a changed-corpus fingerprint; rebuilt against the new corpus before applying.
Five final source-context follow-ups were incomplete; the affected relationships stayed withheld.
Earlier real browser runs produced incomplete cores, disconnected insights, invalid classifications and a copied input response. All recorded attempts remain in the sanitized live report.
One browser run targeted the older 8765 server accidentally; it was stopped and rerun explicitly against 8767. It is not candidate acceptance evidence.
Two stale test assertions expected one four-node review batch after the implementation changed to two-node batches; corrected to verify each original insight is checked exactly once.
